questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “ether”?

options.label: A
options.text: A ring-opening reaction where nucleophiles attack the more substituted, more carbocation-like carbon of a protonated epoxide.

options.label: B
options.text: An organic compound in which an oxygen atom is covalently bonded to two alkyl or aryl carbon groups (R-O-R').

options.label: C
options.text: An organic sulfur compound containing a sulfhydryl (-SH) functional group attached to a carbon atom, characterized by greater acidity than alcohols.

options.label: D
options.text: An SN2 reaction between an alkoxide anion and an unhindered primary alkyl halide or tosylate to synthesize unsymmetrical ethers.

questions.correct_answer: An organic compound in which an oxygen atom is covalently bonded to two alkyl or aryl carbon groups (R-O-R').
